ideas.title: Exam-style pencil-outline figures inside Ask answers
ideas.detail: When an Ask answer is diagram-worthy (a flow, cycle, map, comparison), render a hand-drawn-style pencil-outline SVG line diagram inline — the kind one sketches in the exam hall — strictly from corpus facts, no external images. Relevant to the question, monochrome, reproducible offline.

action.current: Ask answers are text + citation only.
action.issue: Diagram-worthy UPSC answers (flows, cycles, maps) lose marks in exams without a sketch; the page cannot show one.
action.fix: Add a pencil-outline SVG renderer: detect diagram-worthy answers (flow/cycle/map keywords + section structure), draw simple hand-style line diagrams from the answer's own steps, monochrome, inline after the relevant section.

ideas.title: Radial mind-tree: center topic, related things as leaves, click for the key fact
ideas.detail: A mind-tree view with the main topic at the center and everything related forming a tree of leaves around it; clicking a leaf shows the key thing about the main center as seen through that leaf (the strongest corpus fact linking them).

action.current: Timeline shows linear spans and connection chips; no center-out tree.
action.issue: Studying one hub topic needs its whole web of relations visible at once, with the linking fact one click away.
action.fix: Add a radial mind-tree: hub at center, mined relations as leaves; clicking a leaf opens the strongest corpus sentence(s) linking leaf to hub.

ideas.title: Map lineage completeness: mine corpus kin facts into the lineage tab
ideas.detail: The map's lineage tab reads mined family edges, but timeline node shards currently carry none (0 kin edges found), while the corpus is full of son-of / succeeded-by / dynasty facts. Mine them with the existing FAMILY_RE relation set and show the evidence sentence for each edge.

action.current: Lineage shows 'No family-lineage links yet' for every person.
action.issue: Corpus sentences state family and succession relations that the map never shows, and wrong ones cannot be spotted.
action.fix: Extend the timeline builder's kin miner (FAMILY_RE relations) so lineage edges land in the node shards, with sentence evidence kept for auditing.
